run_ray_pipeline: run a data processing pipeline on a Ray cluster with configurable tasks, workers, and multi-node support
create_ray_executor: create a RayPipelineExecutor with pipeline steps, task counts, resource limits, and distributed logging configuration
manage_ray_task_groups: manage Ray task groups with placement groups, timeout tracking, and automatic resubmission on retriable failures
build_multi_node_ray_job: build a multi-node Ray job that distributes pipeline ranks across nodes using placement groups and node IP discovery
handle_ray_task_failures: handle Ray task failures by detecting retriable errors, resubmitting failed ranks, and enforcing maximum retry limits
